core_obligations: Choose the flat replacement concentrated in the interval (proof lines 17157-17159).
Record that the base changed complex computes the derived tensor product (proof lines 17160-17162).
Show its terms are flat and conclude by the characterisation over the new ring (proof lines 17163-17167).
proof_roadmap: Flat replacement in the interval (proof lines 17157-17159).
Base change computes the derived tensor product with flat terms (proof lines 17160-17164).
Apply the criterion over the new ring (proof lines 17165-17167).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that base changing a complex of modules with tor amplitude in a given interval along a ring map produces a complex over the new ring with tor amplitude in the same interval. The proof uses the characterisation of tor amplitude by a complex of flat modules concentrated in the interval: a quasi-isomorphism from such a complex is chosen, the base changed complex computes the derived tensor product and has flat terms because base change of flat modules is flat, and the characterisation is applied again over the new ring.
